title: Route 14
intro: A bus route with one stop too many. The lantern is lit.
body: I drive the last bus on Route 14. Twelve stops, then the depot. Last Tuesday, someone rang the bell after stop twelve. There's nothing out there. Just fields, and one dead streetlight. I checked the mirror. One passenger. A woman in a wet yellow raincoat, hood up, on the back seat. I never saw her get on. I pulled over under the streetlight. It flickered on. The doors hissed open. She didn't move. I turned around. The back seat was empty. Just a puddle, and the smell of river water. I faced the road again, and the camera screen above my head showed her. Standing right behind my seat.
outro: Route 14 still runs every night. If the bell rings after the last stop, keep driving.
